preconditions.description: The length of the input string S must be between 1 and 1,000,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S must contain only uppercase letters from A to Z.

postconditions.description: The output must be the winner's name and score or 'Draw' if scores are equal.

postconditions.expression: score_stuart == sum(S[i:].count(sub) for i in range(len(S)) if S[i] not in 'AEIOU' for sub in (S[i:i+j] for j in range(1, len(S) - i + 1)))
postconditions.description: Stuart's score is calculated based on the occurrences of substrings starting with consonants.

postconditions.expression: score_kevin == sum(S[i:].count(sub) for i in range(len(S)) if S[i] in 'AEIOU' for sub in (S[i:i+j] for j in range(1, len(S) - i + 1)))
postconditions.description: Kevin's score is calculated based on the occurrences of substrings starting with vowels.
